description: This file implements core functions for a TLS Hso Server Object, including creation, removal, enrollment of objects, and initialization functions, primarily in C language for a network security module.

classes.name: TLS_HSO_SERVER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the TLS Hso Server, encapsulating state and behavior related to TLS server functions.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE TlsHsoServerCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new TLS Hso Server object, setting up its basic properties and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsHsoServerRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the TLS Hso Server object and performs any necessary cleanup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsHsoServerEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls all the necessary sub-objects required by the TLS Hso Server, such as timers and other components.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsHsoServerInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Hso Server object, setting default properties and binding function implementations.
